sql: select count(*) from red_alerts where source_agent = 'intel_red_alert' and detail->'rules' ? 'legal_doc'

select count(*) from red_alerts r join intel_items i on r.detail->>'intel_item_id' = i.id::text where i.url like '%tt-thu-it-03' and r.detail->'rules' ? 'regulation' and not (r.detail->'rules' ? 'legal_doc')
select count(*) from approval_queue where object_type = 'legal_doc_review'
